title: Concept: Pipfile dependency declared with a wildcard
description: Pipfile declares a Pipfile dependency whose specifier is `*`, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: Every release satisfies the entry, so the install follows whatever the index publishes next.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through Pipfile (pypi).
risk: Every release satisfies the entry, so the install follows whatever the index publishes next.
